## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `azure-ai-search-index-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create an Azure AI search service

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to the [Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com). -->
2. Select **Create a resource** and search for **Azure AI Search**.
3. Select **Azure AI Search**.
4. Select **Create**.
5. <!-- manual: Fill in the required fields: -->
6. <!-- manual: Subscription: Select your Azure subscription. -->
7. <!-- manual: Resource group: Select an existing resource group or create a new one. -->
8. <!-- manual: Service name: Enter a unique name (this becomes part of your endpoint URL). -->
9. <!-- manual: Location: Choose a region close to your users. -->
10. <!-- manual: Pricing tier: Select a tier (the Free tier is available for testing). -->
11. Select **Review + create**.
12. Select **Create**.
13. Wait for the deployment to complete, then click **Go to resource**.

## Step 3: Create a search index

1. <!-- manual: In your Azure AI Search service, navigate to Indexes in the left menu. -->
2. Select **Add index** to create a new index.
3. <!-- manual: Define your index schema by adding fields with their names, types, and attributes (searchable, filterable, sortable, facetable, retrievable). -->
4. <!-- manual: Optionally configure Suggesters if you plan to use the autocomplete or suggest features. -->
5. <!-- manual: Optionally configure Scoring profiles for custom relevance tuning. -->
6. Select **Create** to finalize the index.

## Step 4: Get the API key and service URL

1. <!-- manual: In your Azure AI Search service, navigate to Settings › Keys in the left menu. -->
2. <!-- manual: Copy one of the Admin keys (for full read-write access) or a Query key (for read-only search access). -->
3. Note your **service URL**, which follows the pattern:.
4. The full endpoint for index operations combines the service URL and index name:.
